rows.source_ko: 중소벤처기업부 (인력정책과), 044-204-7448
rows.text_en: Ministry of SMEs and Startups ( Human Resources Policy Division ), 044-204-7448

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「중소기업인력지원 특별법」 및 동법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2006. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on Human Resource Support for Small and Medium Enterprises and its Enforcement Decree, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof. <Amended June 2, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(위원의 위촉) 「중소기업인력지원 특별법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제4조제2항에서 “중소벤처기업부령이 정하는 기관”이라 함은 다음 각 호의 기관을 말한다. <개정 2006. 6. 2., 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Appointment of Members) In Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Human Resource Support for Small and Medium Enterprises (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “institutions prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups” refers to the institutions listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 2, 2006; March 23, 2013; July 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 특별시ㆍ광역시 및 도
rows.text_en: 1. Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, and Provinces

rows.source_ko: 2. 「지방교육자치에 관한 법률」 제36조제1항의 규정에 따른 교육청
rows.text_en: 2. Office of Education pursuant to the provisions of Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Local Educational Autonomy Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「고등교육법」 제2조제1호 내지 제4호 및 제6호의 규정에 따른 대학
rows.text_en: 3. Universities pursuant to the provisions of Article 2, Subparagraphs 1 through 4 and 6 of the Higher Education Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「직업안정법」 제4조제1호의 규정에 따른 직업안정기관
rows.text_en: 4. Employment security agency pursuant to Article 4, Subparagraph 1 of the Employment Security Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 「중소기업협동조합법」 제3조제1항제4호에 따른 중소기업중앙회 및 지회
rows.text_en: 5. The Korea Federation of Small and Medium Business and its branches pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Small and Medium Business Cooperatives Act

rows.source_ko: 6. 국ㆍ공립 연구기관
rows.text_en: 6. National and public research institutions

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 지방중소벤처기업청장이 중소기업 인력지원에 기여한다고 인정하는 인력양성기관
rows.text_en: 7. Other workforce training institutions recognized by the Regional Administrator of the Small and Medium Business Administration as contributing to workforce support for SMEs

rows.source_ko: 제3조(산학협약의 내용) 영 제6조제1항에서 “중소벤처기업부령으로 정하는 내용”이라 함은 다음 각호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2006. 6. 2., 2013. 3. 23., 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Contents of Industry-Academic Agreements) In Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “contents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups” refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended June 2, 2006; March 23, 2013; July 26, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 협약당사자
rows.text_en: 1. Parties to the Convention

rows.source_ko: 2. 「중소기업인력지원 특별법」 제8조제1항 각호의 규정에 따른 산학협력사업의 추진계획
rows.text_en: 2. Implementation plan for industry-academia cooperation projects pursuant to the provisions of each subparagraph of Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on Support for Human Resources in Small and Medium Enterprises

rows.source_ko: 3. 사업재원의 배분
rows.text_en: 3. Allocation of project funds

rows.source_ko: 4. 협약내용의 변경에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning changes to the contents of the agreement

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 중소벤처기업부장관이 산학협약의 원활한 추진을 위하여 필요하다고 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of SMEs and Startups for the smooth implementation of industry-academia agreements
Article 4 Deleted <June 2, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(중소기업지원시책 우대) 중소벤처기업부장관은 중소기업지원시책을 집행함에 있어 법률 제6974호 근로기준법중개정법률 부칙 제1조 각호의 규정에 따른 시행일보다 근로시간을 조기에 단축한 중소기업을 우대할 수 있다. <개정 2017. 7. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Preferential Treatment in Support Policies for Small and Medium Enterprises) In implementing support policies for small and medium enterprises, the Minister of SMEs and Startups may give preferential treatment to small and medium enterprises that reduce working hours earlier than the effective date pursuant to the provisions of each subparagraph of Article 1 of the Addenda to Act No. 6974, the Act Amending the Labor Standards Act. <Amended July 26, 2017>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy Decree No. 220, Jan. 24, 2004>

rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy Decree No. 341, June 2, 2006>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 2006년 6월 4일부터 시행한다. 다만, 제2조제5호의 개정규정은 2006년 7월 29일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: This rule shall enter into force on June 4, 2006. However, the amended provision of Article 2, subparagraph 5 shall enter into force on July 29, 2006.

rows.text_en: ③ The Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on Support for Human Resources in Small and Medium Enterprises are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 각 호 외의 부분 및 제3조 각 호 외의 부분 중 “산업자원부령”을 각각 “산업통상자원부령”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the numbered items of Article 2 and the part other than the numbered items of Article 3, “Ordinance of the Ministry of Industry and Resources” shall be changed to “Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy.”

rows.source_ko: ④부터 ⑦까지 생략
rows.text_en: Omit ④ through ⑦

rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of SMEs and Startups Decree No. 1, July 26, 2017> (Enforcement Rule of the Organizational Structure of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.text_en: ⑧ Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on Human Resource Support for Small and Medium Enterprises is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 각 호 외의 부분 및 제3조 각 호 외의 부분 중 “산업통상자원부령”을 각각 “중소벤처기업부령”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 2 and Article 3, the term “Ordinance of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy” shall be changed to “Ordinance of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups.”

rows.source_ko: 제2조제7호 중 “지방중소기업청장”을 “지방중소벤처기업청장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 2, subparagraph 7, “Director of the Regional Small and Medium Business Administration” shall be changed to “Director of the Regional Small and Medium Venture Business Administration”.

rows.source_ko: 제3조제5호 및 제5조 중 “중소기업청장”을 각각 “중소벤처기업부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 3, subparagraph 5 and Article 5, “Administrator of the Small and Medium Business Administration” shall be changed to “Minister of SMEs and Startups”.

rows.text_en: Omit ⑨ through ⑬
